name: environment-snapshot

base_results.finding: known-good binary plus corrected ports did not reproduce under current environment

purpose: Capture a committed, replayable live environment snapshot before any more throughput recovery attempts. This prevents further untracked drift across binary, service env, systemd limits, process topology, sockets, CPU/memory state, and RPC metrics.

result.decision: Kept diagnostic. Future live benchmarks must reference this snapshot or a newer committed snapshot before comparing TPS.

notes: The snapshot redacts KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN from env files and process environments.
This item is a reproducibility gate, not a TPS run. The next benchmark should reference this snapshot or a later snapshot explicitly.
